title: Virus Spread Simulation
description: Interactive network simulation demonstrating how viruses spread through a population. Features adjustable infection probability and visualizes epidemic dynamics through a social contact network of 100 individuals.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Epidemiology
Network Science
Virus Spread
Disease Transmission
Graph Theory
Public Health
Agent-Based Modeling
learningObjectives: Predict how raising the transmission probability r from 0 to 0.4 changes the number of steps needed to infect the 100-node population
Explain how a virus propagates along network edges from 3 initially infected nodes to their 3-6 connected neighbors
Analyze the S-shaped epidemic curve by stepping the simulation and tracking the infected count at each step
Distinguish the roles of node degree and transmission probability in determining how fast an outbreak spreads
Evaluate how reducing contact edges models public health interventions such as social distancing
